description: Real NVDA headlines used as a selector/substrate regression set. Titles are verbatim from the stored 1,181-article corpus. This pins which headlines the deterministic priority signal treats as reports of a disclosure or corporate action, and which it treats as commentary, preview, editorial, or price reaction. It is not a materiality judgement and is not the future M5 gold set.
